summary: SOBR Safe, Inc. (the Company) filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026, announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Clean World Ventures, Inc. (CWV) via a merger of its wholly owned subsidiary, Merger Sub, into CWV, with CWV surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The deal is structured as a stock-for-stock exchange intended to qualify as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). At close, pre-Merger CWV stockholders will own ~98.3% of the combined company, while pre-Merger SOBR stockholders will own ~1.7%, implying a reverse merger dynamic. No cash consideration, premium, or break fee are stated. The board's recommendation is not explicitly noted. What to watch: regulatory and stockholder approvals; the extreme dilution to existing SOBR holders suggests CWV is the de facto acquirer.
